content.comment_body: Hello [product_name] Community, Do you know if the current errors will be resolved soon in an upcoming version of [product_name]? I'm involved in sales as a [company_name] APP, and customers have expressed negative feedback about the error messages in [product_name]. They feel the quality is lacking. I try to assist by managing the environment settings, but it's not an easy solution for the average user. I appreciate any insights from the community.
This forum is run by users. If you have direct questions for [company_name], you should submit a Support Request.

I can confirm that development is working on the next version of [product_name], and features are being enhanced. Decisions about improvements are made by the product manager in collaboration with the development team, not by support staff. If you work at [company_name], it's best to communicate with the product manager for [product_name]. Otherwise, you can submit your feedback through a Support Request, though support may not guarantee specific changes. Tip: If you encounter a new issue, filing a Service Request helps, as only known problems can be addressed and improved.

analysis.insight_summary: Users express dissatisfaction with recurring and confusing error messages in [product_name], considering them unprofessional. There's uncertainty over when and how these issues will be fixed in upcoming updates, leading to frustration, especially since the current workaround is not accessible for typical customers.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is hoping for a quick fix to the errors in [product_name] and expects more reliable and professional error management. Timely updates and enhanced stability are sought to better serve customers.
